title: Linux Systems Engineer
description:
Zolon is a prime contractor with the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), supporting a 5-year initiative for software development, business intelligence, ERP, and infrastructure optimization. We are seeking a Linux Systems Engineer to join our Operations team. This role involves supporting federal government operations in managing multiple platforms in a cloud-enabled DevOps environment.

Key Responsibilities:
Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain Linux servers (RHEL, Amazon Linux).
Manage user accounts, permissions, file systems, and system resources.
Monitor system performance, capacity, and resource utilization.
Troubleshot complex system issues and outages, working with vendor support, performing incident root cause analysis.
Implement and maintain system backup and disaster recovery solutions.
Maintain comprehensive documentation of system configurations and procedures, and runbooks.
Design, deploy, and manage infrastructure in AWS (EC2, VPC, S3, IAM, CloudFormation, Lambda).
Some knowledge supporting and maintaining Azure cloud resources (Virtual Machines, Storage, Networking, Azure AD).
Implement cloud security best practices and compliance controls.
Experiencing developing automation scripts using Bash, Python, or PowerShell.
Knowledge of implementing system provisioning and patching systems using Ansible.
Proficiency in system performance tuning and troubleshooting

Required Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
5+ years of Linux patch management and upgrade experience.
Manage security remediation in accordance with federal security requirements.
Coordinate maintenance windows with stakeholders and minimize system downtime
Familiarity using tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, and Confluence.
Track and report on patch compliance metrics
Support security audits, vulnerability assessments to ensure our systems are secure.
Strong command-line proficiency and shell scripting (Bash, Python).
Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).

Preferred Qualifications:
Familiar with Terraform, Ansible, or other infrastructure-as-code tools.
Experience working on federal government contracts.
Familiarity with federal security standards (FISMA, NIST 800-53, FedRAMP).
Experience with container technologies (Kubernetes).
Ability to optimize system performance based on monitoring data and metrics.
Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents quickly and effectively, and conduct post-incident and outage review.
Deep understanding of Linux system architecture, kernel, and system services.

Clearance: Ability to obtain Public Trust clearance
Location: Preferred candidates local to the DC Metro area

title: Database Engineer
description:
Zolon is a prime contractor with the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), supporting a 5-year initiative for software development, business intelligence, ERP, and infrastructure optimization. We are seeking a Database Engineer to join our Operations team. This role involves supporting federal government operations in managing multiple database platforms in a cloud-enabled DevOps environment.

Key Responsibilities:
Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, and Oracle databases.
Monitor database performance and optimize queries, indexes, and database structures to ensure efficient operations.
Perform database capacity planning and implement scalable solutions to match growth trends.
Implement and maintain database security policies, access controls, and audit procedures.
Execute database backup and recovery procedures to ensure data integrity and availability.
Manage database users and database roles across multiple cloud environments,
Deploy and manage databases in AWS and Azure cloud environments (RDS, Aurora, EC2, DynamoDB).
Integrate database operations with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps workflows to streamline database management.
Support containerized database deployments and orchestration using modern DevOps tools.
Monitor system health using database management tools and respond to database alerts.
Troubleshoot and resolve database-related issues in production and test environments.
Document database architectures, procedures, and troubleshooting guides.

Required Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
5+ years of database administration experience managing one of the following platforms: MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, or Oracle.
Strong hands-on experience with AWS core database services (EC2, RDS, Aurora).
Demonstrated experience working in a DevOps or Agile development environment.
Familiarity with tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, and Confluence.
Strong proficiency in SQL and database query optimization.
Experience with database monitoring and performance analysis tools.
Commitment to maintaining data security and adaptability to meet rapidly changing

Preferred Qualifications:
Familiar with Terraform, Ansible, or other infrastructure-as-code tools.
Experience working on federal government contracts.
Familiarity with federal security standards (FISMA, NIST 800-53, FedRAMP).
Experience with container technologies (Kubernetes).
Familiarity with RDBMS and cloud-native database solutions.

Clearance: Ability to obtain Public Trust clearance
Location: Preferred candidates local to the DC Metro area

title: Chief Systems Engineer
description:
To acquire the advantage, Zolon is seeking a Chief Systems Engineer to assist in leading engineering teams in taking a multi-disciplinary approach to requirements engineering, solutions engineering, scheduling, reliability, resiliency,
services development, integration, test and evaluation, maintainability, and analysis across the
NSG, ASG, and Federal Agencies to ensure timely and accurate GEOINT.

Duties may include:
Assist the Government in directing requirements engineering, solutions engineering,
scheduling, reliability, resiliency, services development, integration, test and evaluation,
maintainability, and analysis across the NSG, ASG, and Federal Agencies.
Assist with the planning, analysis/traceability of user requirements, architectures traceability,
procedures, and problems to automate or improve existing systems and review cloud service
capabilities, workflow, and scheduling limitations.
Advise the Government on proposed changes to the solution designs based on analysis of
requirements and new technology.
Assist the Government in the capture and translation of mission and customer
requirements/needs into systems/capability requirements and solutions.
Support the analyses and allocation of requirements to systems architecture components and
executing programs.
Assist the Government in performing systems integration activities.
Assist in leading AoAs, CoAs, Trade Studies, and Engineering Assessments.
Assist the Government in strategic technical planning, project management, performance
engineering, risk management, and interface design.
Provide expert advice to the Government in the areas of vision, strategy, plans,
needs, requirements, process, and capability developments.
Oversee and coordinate the work of Senior-, Mid-, and Junior-level contractor Systems
Engineers.

Skills and Experience:
Required:
Master's degree or higher in Systems Engineering or in related technical or scientific fields
such as engineering, physics, mathematics, operations research, and engineering management,
Computer Science, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, or related
STEM degree.
Expert-level experience in relevant work areas, including: DoD/IC Acquisition Process,
Requirements Process, Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution System (PPBES)
Process, or system engineering of a large complex System of Systems or Service Oriented
Architecture/Cloud environments.
Expert-level experience with systems engineering lifecycle.

Desired:
Demonstrated experience with MBSE, processes, tools, and languages.
Software Development Framework certification.
INCOSE Expert System Engineering Professional (ESEP) certification.
Licensed Professional Engineer (PE).
Membership or leadership participation in any of the following professional organizations:
American Society for Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing (ASPRS)
Open Geospatial Consortium (OGC)
United States Geospatial Intelligence Foundation (USGIF)
Demonstrated experience in the field of geospatial intelligence.
Demonstrated experience in engineering solutions using structured and unstructured Big Data,
AAA, and Cloud-based technologies.
Demonstrated experience with photogrammetry, remote sensing, image science, information
sciences, geographic information systems, geomatics, or related fields.• Demonstrated knowledge of the current NSG/ASG and NRO enterprises.

Location: Springfield, VA (Onsite)
Clearance: TS/SCI (Polygraph within 90 days of hire date)

title: AWS DevSecOps Engineer
description:

Job Duties:
Design, develop, and maintain automated deployment of systems on AWS cloud.
Configure, deploy, and manage infrastructure in AWS, leveraging core services including EC2, S3, VPCs, security groups, CloudTrail, CloudWatch, SSM, Inspector, and IAM
Manage AWS security and compliance, performance, cloud resources, costs, and budgeting
Automating backups, disaster recovery, and incident response.
Partner with cross-functional teams, such as Security, Architecture, Governance, and others to comply with governance and security requirements.
Automated monitoring of systems in production and troubleshooting.
Understand Architecture Design Patterns.
Ensures platform implementation has appropriate design patterns and coding standards in place. Continuously works toward secure and scalable solutions.
Continuous Integration and Deployment (CI/CD), build, test, and maintain infrastructure and tools to develop and release software.
Work with emerging technologies to develop solutions supporting development and migration (to AWS cloud) efforts that support the client's mission.

Candidates must have the ability to obtain and maintain an HHS Public Trust clearance.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience/combined education.

Hands-on experience with other IaC automation technologies like Ansible and CloudFormation.
Experience with Infrastructure Capacity Monitoring and Automated Scaling solutions.
10+ years of hands-on experience designing and implementing container (Docker) solutions on Kubernetes or Amazon ECS.
Experience setting up the Qualys tool
Networking protocols such as HTTP, DNS, and TCP/IP
Using Git as a version control platform

Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in RDBMS (Oracle, etc.)

title: Sr. Network & Computer Systems Administrator
description:
To acquire the advantage, Zolon seeks a Senior Network and Computer Systems Administrator to support this Program. The Telecommunications Support Program provides comprehensive IT and telecommunications services to the National Vehicle and Fuel Emissions Laboratory (NVFEL). The Program aims to support the laboratory's mission of conducting emissions testing and ensuring compliance with federal emissions and fuel economy standards. The Program covers various services, including desktop management, data center management, enterprise connectivity, IT security, business support, and application services.

Duties:
• Provide installation and maintenance support for all EPA servers.
• Support all guest operating systems and servers installed on hosts, analyze system responses, and provide monthly system performance metrics (VMWare, Windows, Linux distributions).
• Troubleshoot hardware and operating system issues, correct problems, rebuild systems, perform systems maintenance, and perform daily operational administration, monitoring, and optimization of server performance.
• Manage Systems/Software/Patching via automated endpoint management solution, for patching and reporting on systems patches, patch testing, software deployment, reporting on systems patched, etc. (currently ManageEngine Desktop Central and Systems Center).
• Maintain maintenance windows in the approved system monitoring tools to ensure system monitoring is paused for the duration of the maintenance period to properly reflect the approved Service Level Agreement (SLA)
• Install and maintain applications on servers, such as Web applications and ETL processing applications.
•Support shall include troubleshooting interoperability issues with other EPA standard applications, log analysis, and maintaining and upgrading the host hardware.
• Monitor data center systems daily using tools like Nagios, Observium, Alienvault, Commvault, Acronis, Cylance, Lansweeper, and EM7. Propose and develop new solutions where needed
• Managed and maintained Storage Appliances, iSCSI, and Fibre Channel Infrastructure
• Optimize Cluster network topology to include fault tolerance and interface bonding
• Manage resource allocations to ensure proper failover is possible in the event of host failure
• Create and configure user accounts, groups, printers, and network shares/folders on a Windows Active Directory environment.
• Perform backups, restores, and troubleshoot problems using Commvault, Acronis, and Windows backup systems on tape, DVD-RW, CD-RW, diskette, and network volumes.
• Candidates must have the ability to obtain and maintain National Agency Check and Inquiries (NACI) level clearance.
• Has applicable training and at least two (2) years of wireless network administration experience and hands-on knowledge/experience in managing, implementing, and securing Wireless Networks.
• At least 3 years of LAN Administrative work experience
• Have taken vendor Microsoft Windows Server Administration classes and have at least three (3) years of demonstrated experience in administering a Microsoft Windows 2012/2016 or later server-networked environment consisting of 10 or more servers operating a variety of networked applications.
• Possess the skills necessary to install and maintain Microsoft, Unix/Linux-based web servers, and terminal servers.
• Experience with the Microsoft Windows Active Directory 20/20 course and be able to administer an Active Directory environment.
• Technical experience to configure, support, and troubleshoot all aspects of layer 1 (data cabling) and layer 2 (switching) of a TCP/IP network.
• Experience with Cisco and Cabletron/Enterasys switching equipment.
• Functional knowledge in the installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and management of Cisco hardware.
• Functional knowledge (installation, configuration, and operation) of all network operating systems (Microsoft Windows, Linux, and VMWare) and the security mechanisms employed by these operating systems.
• Experience and the ability to identify (using tools such as Splunk) and diagnose systems (O/S, applications, hacks, etc.) and security issues, communicate changes required per site processes, and implement the changes with minimal impact on the user community.
• Ability to terminate cables on a variety of jacks, panels, and terminal blocks.
• Experience with backup and restores on the Windows, DOS, UNIX, and Linux operating systems.
• Ability to install and support all aspects of computer hardware, such as hard drives, external media, fans, power supplies, controllers, system boards, processors, and memory.
• Troubleshoot and correct basic problems for various printers, fax machines, and network scanners.
• Able to replace toners and drum kits as required.
• Ability to install, diagnose, repair, patch, and support various operating systems (Windows and all flavors of Linux).
• Ability to create and distribute a standard image for new computers using Acronis.
• Ability to install and support various Windows-based software applications and distribute them from the network when appropriate
• Experience with centralized logging systems like Graylog, Splunk, or SIEM

Required Education and Certification(s):
• Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or Information Technology, or equivalent experience/combined education.
• Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) certification and/or Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) certification

Clearance: Ability to obtain Public Trust
Location: On-site Ann Arbor, MI
